title: Remote Sales Professional (Appointment Setter to Closer)
description:
ABOUT US:

Zen Companies Inc. (
) is a fast-growing, industry-leading agency specializing in AI automations, high-converting funnels, systems, and customized CRM solutions. Our mission is to bridge the gap in the coming AI-driven economy by equipping businesses with the tools they need to thrive. We have helped clients generate over $40 million in revenue, and we run a significant portion of our operations with our talented remote team in the Philippines.



THE ROLE & CAREER PATH:

We are looking for hungry, highly motivated, and diligent Sales Professionals to join our remote team. This role is open to remote Filipino workers anywhere in the Philippines. This is a unique opportunity with a clear growth pipeline:



PHASE 1 — APPOINTMENT SETTER (Entry to Mid-Level):

You will start by prospecting B2B leads, initiating conversations, qualifying prospects, and booking appointments. You'll learn our systems, our pitch, and our industry inside and out.



PHASE 2 — SALES CLOSER (Senior Level):

Once you have proven your ability to generate pipeline and understand our offerings, you will be promoted to a Closer. In this role, you will conduct discovery calls with pre-qualified B2B business owners, present our custom AI and funnel solutions, overcome objections, and close high-ticket deals.



WHY ZEN COMPANIES?

We pay TOP commissions — the LARGEST upfront percentage AND monthly recurring revenue (MRR) percentage in the industry. ALL compensation is PAID IN USD. We don't just talk about rewarding performance — we prove it. Top producers earn bonuses, trips, and an annual all-expenses-paid trip to our corporate office in the United States to attend our award ceremonies. If you want to be treated like a top-tier closer and get paid like one, this is the place.



LOW ENERGY, LOW PERFORMING PEOPLE NEED NOT APPLY. THIS IS NOT FOR YOU.

We are looking for KILLERS. People who wake up hungry and go to bed satisfied because they crushed their goals. If you need hand-holding, constant motivation, or can't handle rejection — keep scrolling. But if you're a self-starter who thrives on competition and wants to earn more than you ever thought possible from the Philippines — READ ON.



HARD SKILLS REQUIRED:

- Experience in B2B sales, outbound prospecting, or telemarketing (Cold Calling,
, Social DMs)

- Excellent conversational English (both written and spoken) with a neutral, professional accent

- Experience navigating CRM software (GoHighLevel experience is a huge plus)

- Ability to follow scripts while sounding natural and conversational

- Basic understanding of marketing funnels, lead generation, or B2B SaaS concepts



SOFT SKILLS REQUIRED:

- Highly resilient, comfortable with rejection, and not afraid to ask for the sale

- Self-starter who is disciplined enough to work remotely

- Goal-oriented and driven by targets and commissions

- Coachable and willing to learn our specific outreach and closing methods

- Reliable high-speed internet connection, a quality headset, and a quiet workspace



RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Identify and source qualified B2B leads in our target verticals (Home Services, Restaurants, Med Spas, etc.)

- Conduct outbound outreach via phone calls,
s, and social media platforms

- Schedule qualified appointments onto the calendars of our Sales Closers

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all interactions in our CRM

- As you advance to Closer: Conduct Zoom/phone sales presentations, handle objections, and close deals



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

- PAID IN USD — Competitive base + the highest upfront commission % and MRR % in the game

- Uncapped earning potential — no ceiling on what you can make

- Performance bonuses and incentive trips

- Annual trip to the US corporate office for top producers (award ceremonies)

- 100% Remote Work from Home — open to Filipino workers anywhere in the Philippines

- Clear career progression from Setter to Closer



HOW TO APPLY:

Please submit your resume along with a short audio or video recording (1-2 minutes) introducing yourself. Tell us about your sales or appointment setting experience and why you would be a great fit for Zen Companies Inc. Applications without a voice/video recording will NOT be considered.

title: Commercial Sales & Customer Success Coordinator – HVAC
description:
Commercial Sales & Customer Success Coordinator – HVAC



About Enviro Air

Enviro Air is a growing HVAC company serving commercial and residential customers. We are building a long-term, collaborative remote team that values clear communication, ownership, and excellent customer service.



The opportunity

We are hiring a full-time Commercial Sales & Customer Success Coordinator to grow and care for our commercial customer base. You will keep opportunities moving—from a new inquiry or site visit through estimate, approval, maintenance-plan enrollment, renewal, and professional follow-up.



Must-haves

• Excellent spoken and written English. You must write clear, polished, professional customer messages without heavy editing.

• Full-time availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours, generally 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Eastern.

• Ability to participate in a rotating on-call schedule for business evenings and weekends.

• Strong organization, reliable follow-through, and a professional, helpful communication style.



Preferred experience

• Prior inside-sales, appointment-setting, commercial customer-service, customer-success, or account-coordination experience is strongly preferred.

• Experience with HVAC, property management, maintenance plans, or a service business is a plus.

• Comfortable with Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and AI tools.



Your work

• Follow up with commercial leads, property managers, and existing customers by
, phone, and text.

• Prepare, send, and track approved commercial maintenance and repair estimates.

• Book commercial site visits, system assessments, and maintenance-planning appointments.

• Support commercial maintenance-plan renewals and targeted outbound prospecting.

• Keep customer notes, next actions, and follow-up dates accurate in our systems.

• Coordinate with technicians, dispatch, and leadership to resolve questions quickly.

• Use AI thoughtfully to improve communication quality, organization, and speed.



Pay and growth

• $4–$6 per hour, based on experience and demonstrated performance.

• Performance bonuses for commercial maintenance-plan sign-ups and renewals.

• Paid training and a long-term growth opportunity.



How to apply

Use exactly 6 Apply Points. In the first line of your application, write: “Commercial growth follow-up is my strength.”



Then send a short introduction covering: your relevant commercial or inside-sales experience; your Eastern Time availability; and one example of how you use AI to improve your work.

title: Accounting Assistant Manager / Senior Accountant – QBO & Xero
description:
Accounting Assistant Manager / Senior Accountant – QBO & Xero



Employment Type: Full-time, Remote

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time

Position Level: Accounting Assistant Manager or Senior Accountant, depending on experience



Position Overview



We are looking for an experienced Accounting Assistant Manager or Senior Accountant to oversee a portfolio of clients using QuickBooks Online and Xero. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and timeliness of accounting records, managing month-end close activities, reviewing the work of accounting staff, and communicating directly with clients.



This role requires strong technical accounting knowledge, hands-on experience with QBO and Xero, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple client engagements.



Key Responsibilities

Oversee the day-to-day accounting activities of multiple QBO and Xero clients.

Manage monthly, quarterly, and year-end closing processes.

Review bank and credit card reconciliations, journal entries, and general ledger accounts.

Review accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and other accounting schedules.

Prepare and review financial statements and management reports.

Analyze financial records and investigate unusual balances, variances, and accounting discrepancies.

Review the work of junior accountants and provide guidance, coaching, and feedback.

Ensure client records are accurate, complete, and maintained in accordance with applicable accounting standards.

Communicate directly with clients regarding open items, accounting issues, deadlines, and required supporting documents.

Assist with accounting cleanups, catch-up bookkeeping, account reconciliations, and process improvements.

Establish and maintain effective internal controls and standardized accounting procedures.

Coordinate with management and other tea
mbers to ensure client deliverables are completed accurately and on time.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

At least five years of professional accounting experience.

At least three years of relevant hands-on experience using QuickBooks Online, Xero, or both.

Strong understanding of general accounting principles, financial reporting, account reconciliations, and month-end closing procedures.

Experience reviewing the work of other accountants or managing an accounting team.

Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.

Ability to manage multiple clients, priorities, and deadlines with minimal supervision.

Must be willing and able to work from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time, corresponding to the Philippine night shift.

title: 24 HR Review | VA Remote Virtual Receptionist
description:
**IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING**



We are currently hiring for a long-term Remote Receptionist position. Responsibilities include answering inbound calls, scheduling appointments, de-escalating complaints, and completing administrative tasks in a fast-paced environment. This is a performance-based role where all calls are recorded and regularly audited for quality assurance.



For candidates who may be a stronger fit outside of a call-handling role, we also have a few non-voice positions available, subject to availability and overall fit. If you are interested, please clearly state that you are interested in a non-voice role and submit a brief three-sentence introduction about yourself along with your portfolio or work samples.



Please note our application process: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unable to respond individually to every applicant who is not selected. If you do not receive a response from us within 24 hours with information about the next step in the hiring process, you were not selected to move forward to the next round. We appreciate your interest and thank you for taking the time to apply.



————————————————————



**To apply:** Please copy the questions below, paste them into your reply, and answer each question thoroughly. Please answer based on your own personal experience and provide specific, real examples whenever requested. Incomplete, vague, generic, or copied responses may not be considered.



**(1)** Which city and region in the Philippines are you currently located in? Which backup solutions do you currently have in place for internet or power interruptions?



**(2)** Please submit a link to a screenshot of your internet speed and links to a few samples of your previous work output or portfolio. Please indicate what work you personally completed.



**(3)** Please submit links to two short voice recordings. Recording one should demonstrate booking an appointment from 7:00 PM to 8:00 PM with a total amount of $60. Recording two should demonstrate handling a double charge for a 90-minute massage where the client sees two $90 charges and is requesting a refund.



**(4)** Are you currently employed or engaged in any other work, business, freelance projects, or income-generating activities? If yes, please briefly describe your current commitments and typical weekly availability.



**(5)** Are you able to commit to a fixed 7-day, 6-hour work schedule during Central Standard Time (CST) hours? What is your expected hourly or monthly pay rate and earliest physical start date if hired?



**(6)** Describe three work tasks you have personally completed at least 100 times in a real job. For each task, give a specific example of when you performed the task, explain exactly what you did in your own words, identify the actual tools or systems you used, and describe the final result. Include any specific details, numbers, or challenges you remember from doing the task.



**(7)** If you were hired today, what are three specific work tasks you believe you could fully handle on your own within your first week? For each example, describe the exact task, the tools or software involved, and what successful completion would look like.



**(8)** What is the highest workload you have personally handled in a single day or in a single week? Please describe it using specific, measurable figures and briefly explain the context of that workload.



**(9)** Briefly introduce yourself and describe the qualities, experiences, work habits, or achievements you believe genuinely set you apart from other applicants for this role.

title: ACCOUNTING & FINANCIAL OPERATIONS SPECIALIST
description:
ACCOUNTING & FINANCIAL OPERATIONS SPECIALIST 



Full-Time | Remote (Philippines) | US Eastern Time Zone 



ABOUT THE ROLE 

We are looking for a detail-oriented Accounting & Financial Operations Specialist  to join a growing, US-based property restoration and remediation company. This is  a full-time, dedicated role supporting the finance and operations team from the  Philippines during US Eastern Time Zone business hours. 



You will own three core areas: managing employee expense and referral fee  tracking, keeping the books clean in QuickBooks Online, and analyzing the  profitability of individual restoration projects through the company's service  management software. If you have strong accounting fundamentals, advanced QBO  skills, and an analytical mindset, this is an excellent opportunity to work with a  well-established company that values accuracy, reliability, and results. 



QUICK DETAILS 

Industry: Property Restoration & Environmental Services 

Schedule: Full-Time, Monday to Friday, 40-45 hrs/week, EST Hours Type: Full-Time, Dedicated (Exclusive) 

Compensation: Competitive (commensurate with experience) 

Start Date: Immediate 



WHAT YOU WILL DO 

Employee Expense & Referral Tracking 

~ Manage and process employee reimbursements, ensuring timely and accurate  payments. 

~ Track specialized payments such as referral fees, commissions, and bonuses,  ensuring proper categorization for tax and reporting purposes. 

~ Maintain organized records with supporting documentation and prepare expense  summaries for payroll and year-end tax preparation. 

QuickBooks Online Mastery 

~ Reconcile credit card statements, bank accounts, and vendor accounts in QBO on a  regular basis. 

~ Reclassify and recategorize transactions to ensure accurate chart of accounts  and financial reporting. 

~ Maintain a clear audit log of all changes, adjustments, and journal entries to 

ensure data integrity. 

~ Generate financial reports (P&L, balance sheets, cash flow) and support month end and year-end close processes. 

~ Identify and resolve discrepancies, duplicate entries, and uncategorized  transactions proactively. 

Job-Level Profitability Analysis 

~ Analyze the profitability of individual remediation projects using the company's  service management software. 

~ Review job costs (labor, materials, subcontractors, overhead) against revenue to  determine project margins. 

~ Identify trends in profitable vs. underperforming job types and present findings  to management. 

~ Cross-reference job data with QuickBooks records to ensure consistency across  systems. 

~ Provide regular profitability reports and dashboards to support strategic  decision-making. 



WHO YOU ARE 

You are a detail-oriented accounting professional who takes pride in clean books  and accurate records. You can reconcile accounts in your sleep, you catch  discrepancies others miss, and you understand how to turn financial data into  insights that help a business grow. You work independently, meet deadlines without  being chased, and communicate clearly when something needs attention. 



MUST HAVE 

~ At least 3 years of experience in bookkeeping, accounting operations, or a  related financial role. 

~ Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online, including reconciliations, journal  entries, reclassifications, and report generation. This is a core requirement. 

~ Experience managing employee expense reimbursements and tracking specialized  payments (referral fees, commissions) for tax purposes. 

~ Strong understanding of accounting fundamentals: debits/credits, chart of  accounts, accrual vs. cash basis, financial statements. 

~ Experience with job costing or project-level profitability analysis, ideally in  construction, restoration, or services. 

~ Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain audit-ready records. 

~ Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify trends and discrepancies. 

~ Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. 

~ Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision. 

~ Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated, quiet home office setup. 

~ Willingness to work full US Eastern Time Zone hours (40-45 hours per week).



NICE TO HAVE 

~ Experience with service management or job costing software (e.g., Xcelerate,  ServiceTitan, or similar). 

~ Background in the property restoration, construction, or home services industry. 

~ Experience supporting US-based companies with tax categorization and compliance. 

~ QuickBooks Online certification (ProAdvisor or equivalent). 

~ Familiarity with payroll processes and coordination with payroll providers.

~ Experience with data visualization or financial dashboards (Excel, Google  Sheets, Tableau). 



IMPORTANT TO KNOW 

Full-Time and Dedicated: This is an exclusive, full-time position. You must work  only for this company and may not hold any other employment, freelance, or contract work at any time. Candidates currently holding multiple jobs will not be considered. 

Time Tracking: Time-tracking software will be installed from Day 1 as part of  standard company policy. 

QuickBooks Online Proficiency is Required: If you do not have hands-on, advanced  QBO experience, please do not apply. Basic familiarity is not sufficient for this  role. 

Performance Based: We invest in people who deliver results. Strong performers have  room to grow, earn more, and take on additional responsibility. 



WHY THIS ROLE 

~ Competitive monthly pay with room to grow for top performers. 

~ Stable, full-time employment with a reputable US company. 

~ Supportive management that provides clear expectations and values your  contribution. 

~ Opportunity to build a long-term career, not just fill a seat. 

~ A team that treats remote professionals as integral members, not outsourced  help. 



HOW TO APPLY 

Submit your updated resume along with a brief message (3 to 5 sentences) answering  the following:

1. How many years of bookkeeping or accounting operations experience do you have? 

2. Describe your QuickBooks Online experience. What specific functions do you use  regularly (reconciliations, journal entries, reclassifications, reporting)? 

3. Do you have experience with job costing or project-level profitability  analysis? If yes, in what industry? 

4. Are you available to work full-time, exclusively, during US Eastern Time Zone  hours? 



Applications without this information may not be reviewed. 



Recruited by Opus Spark | opusspark.co 



Confidential: Client information will be shared with qualified candidates.

title: Amazon Book Keeper

Part-Time Bookkeeper — Amazon FBA & FBM Business



Hours: Part-time, flexible (approx. 5–10 hrs/week to start)

Location: Remote



We are looking for an experienced part-time Bookkeeper to help manage the finances of our Amazon FBA and FBM e-commerce business. If you have experience bookkeeping for online sellers, retailers, or inventory-based businesses, please note that in your application.



?? This role is strictly for someone with e-commerce or retail bookkeeping experience looking for part-time, ongoing work. If your background is primarily general/personal bookkeeping with no exposure to inventory, COGS, or online marketplace fees, this role will not be a good fit.



What You'll Be Doing (Part-Time, Ongoing):



Reconciling bank and credit card statements monthly

Tracking and categorizing business expenses (inventory purchases, shipping, FBA fees, FBM shipping/fulfillment costs, warehouse costs, ad spend)

Managing accounts payable/receivable

Preparing monthly profit & loss statements

Tracking COGS (cost of goods sold) per product/category and calculating true margins after fees — separately for FBA and FBM listings

Reconciling Amazon Seller Central payout reports against actual bank deposits, for both FBA and FBM order types

Tracking FBM-specific costs (outbound shipping labels, packaging, third-party carrier fees)

Assisting with GST/HST filing and general tax prep

Maintaining organized digital records of invoices, receipts, and supplier statements

Flagging discrepancies (returns, chargebacks, fee errors, missing payouts)

Providing clean, organized monthly financial summaries and cash flow insights



Required Experience:



Proven experience bookkeeping for an e-commerce, retail, or inventory-based business

Strong understanding of COGS, inventory accounting, and marketplace fee structures for both FBA and FBM

Comfortable working with bookkeeping software (QuickBooks, Xero, Wave, or similar)

Experience with Excel/spreadsheets

Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central reports (Payments, Inventory, Fee reports) is strongly preferred

Knowledge of Canadian GST/HST filing basics is a plus

Available for consistent part-time hours (flexible schedule, but reliable weekly/monthly availability needed)



Important – Please Answer in Your Application

To be considered, you must answer the following:



How long have you been doing bookkeeping for e-commerce/retail businesses?

Have you worked with inventory-based businesses before? If yes, explain how you tracked COGS and inventory.

Have you bookkept for a business running both FBA and FBM? If yes, explain how you kept the two separate in your records.

Which bookkeeping software have you used? (QuickBooks, Xero, Wave, etc.)

Have you reconciled Amazon Seller Central (or similar marketplace) payouts before? If yes, briefly describe your process.

Briefly describe your month-end close process.

Have you ever helped a small business scale its books as it grew? If yes, explain your role.

What part-time hours/schedule works best for you?

Competitive pay based on experience (part-time hourly rate)

Long-term opportunity for the right candidate

title: Customer Support Virtual Assistant
description:
LVLUP Health Customer Support Virtual Assistants

Two Remote Contract Positions | 15–30 Hours Per Week | Applicants Worldwide Welcome



Company Description

LVLUP Health is a wellness brand focused on delivering effective, science-backed supplements in the health and biohacking space. Founded in 2020 by nutritionist and naturopath Kyal Van Der Leest, the company challenges industry norms by creating practitioner-grade formulations that prioritise real results.

LVLUP Health combines cutting-edge peptide science, advanced nutritional actives and carefully selected herbal extracts to support the body’s ability to heal, recover and thrive. Our products are practitioner-formulated, batch-tested for purity and trusted by clinics, dispensaries, health food stores and health professionals around the world.

Our mission is simple: to empower individuals and practitioners with tools that elevate performance, resilience and wellbeing.

About the Roles

We are seeking two highly organised and customer-focused Customer Support Virtual Assistants to join our growing remote team.



These roles involve more than simply responding to support tickets. You will help deliver an exceptional customer experience while assisting with ecommerce operations, subscriptions, order management, fulfilment issues and payment disputes across multiple systems and websites.



You will work closely with our Customer Experience Manager and wider operations team to solve customer issues, improve support processes and maintain high service standards across our international ecommerce business.

Each position offers approximately 15–30 hours per week, with the possibility of additional hours as the company and the role continue to grow.



Key Responsibilities

Customer Support

Manage customer enquiries through
 and Zendesk.

Provide timely, empathetic and solutions-focused customer support.

Assist with order issues, subscription enquiries, returns, refunds and exchanges.

Escalate complex customer concerns to the Customer Experience Manager.

Follow up on unresolved enquiries and ensure customers receive a clear outcome.

Maintain high customer satisfaction and response-time standards.

Accurately document customer interactions and actions taken.



Ecommerce Support

Navigate and work across multiple ecommerce websites and platforms.

Troubleshoot customer accounts, subscriptions and ordering issues.

Process approved refunds, replacements and account updates.

Monitor product pages and report website or checkout issues.

Assist with maintaining FAQs, Help Centre articles and customer response templates.

Identify recurring customer problems and report them to management.



Fulfilment and Shipping Support

Liaise with ShipBob, shipping carriers and other fulfilment providers.

Investigate lost, delayed, damaged or incorrectly fulfilled orders.

Submit support requests and follow up with logistics providers until issues are resolved.

Keep customers informed throughout shipping investigations.

Escalate recurring or complex fulfilment issues to management.

Maintain accurate records of shipping issues and resolutions.



Payment Disputes and Chargeback Support

Assist with investigating PayPal disputes and payment chargebacks.

Gather order records, tracking information and customer correspondence.

Prepare supporting evidence for review by the Customer Experience Manager.

Maintain accurate records and monitor dispute outcomes.

Escalate suspected fraud or recurring dispute patterns to management.



Systems and Process Improvement

Follow established Standard Operating Procedures and company policies.

Assist with updating customer support templates and internal documentation.

Track relevant customer support and operational information.

Support AI-assisted customer service and process-automation initiatives.

Identify recurring issues and suggest practical improvements.

Collaborate with customer support, operations and marketing tea
mbers as required.



Platforms and Systems

Experience with some or all of the following is highly desirable:

Zendesk

WooCommerce

Shopify

ShipBob

PayPal

Subscription management platforms

Notion

Slack

Google Workspace

AI tools such as ChatGPT

Experience with every platform is not required, but you must be comfortable learning new systems quickly.



About You

You are:

A confident communicator with excellent written English.

Customer-focused, patient and solutions-oriented.

Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail.

Comfortable working across multiple systems and browser tabs.

Able to prioritise competing tasks in a fast-paced remote environment.

Proactive, dependable and willing to take ownership of your work.

Comfortable asking questions and escalating issues when necessary.

title: B2B list building; property management companies, 5 US metros
description:
Hello all, 



I run furnished mid-term rentals and am building a database of property management companies that handle this type of property. Most PMs only handle unfurnished long-term rentals, so the whole point of this project is to identify the exceptions.



What I need: roughly 150 companies across Houston, TX; Nashville, TN;  Charlotte, NC; Columbus, OH; and Rochester, MN (around 30 per city). For each one, I need the basics (name, phone,
, website) plus your read on whether they manage furnished mid-term or corporate rentals for property owners.



You'd be working from the National Association of Residential Property Managers (NARPM) member directory, Google Maps, Zillow rental listings, and company websites. I'll give you a spreadsheet template and a full brief for clarity.



One thing that matters a lot to me: every "yes" needs a source URL. I will want to see the actual page where you found the evidence. And if you genuinely can't tell either way, mark it unknown. I'd much rather have an honest "couldn't find it" than a guess. I'll be making phone calls based on this list, so accuracy matters more than speed.



How it works: we’ll start with a paid 10-row test for Nashville to make sure we're on the same page. If that goes well, we move to the first three cities, then the last two. Each stage gets reviewed and paid before the next one starts.



When you apply, tell me one property management company in any of these cities that looks like a fit and why.

title: Real Estate Cold Caller
description:
I am looking for a reliable and professional virtual assistant to call property owners from a tax-delinquent real estate list. The goal is to have respectful conversations with owners, determine whether they may be interested in selling their property, and identify genuinely motivated leads for follow-up.



You will be provided with:



- Property-owner names and phone numbers

- Property addresses

- A prepared call script

- A lead-tracking sheet

- Clear instructions for classifying each call



Responsibilities:



- Call every phone number provided for each property.

- Follow the prepared script while speaking naturally and professionally.

- Confirm that you are speaking with the correct property owner.

- Ask whether the owner would consider selling the property.

- Gather important details, including motivation, desired price, property condition, timeline, and any other issues affecting the sale.

- Determine whether the person is a hot, warm, cold, or uninterested lead based on the provided criteria.

- Record detailed and accurate notes after every conversation.

- Update the result of every call, including no answer, voi
, wrong number, disconnected number, callback requested, or interested seller.

- Call additional numbers for the same property when the first number does not reach the correct owner.

- Stop calling additional numbers once the correct owner has been reached and the necessary information has been collected.

- Follow up on callbacks and leads according to the instructions provided.

- Never pressure, threaten, mislead, or make assumptions about an owner’s financial situation.



Important



This is not a position for someone who only reads a script and quickly moves to the next number. I need someone who listens carefully, asks appropriate follow-up questions, and provides detailed notes so I can understand exactly what happened during each call.

title: CPH Social Media Coordinator
description:
BASE PAY PLUS UP TO $15/HR COMMISSION BASED ON EXPERIENCE!



CPH is a growing UK property matchmaking platform that connects care providers with suitable properties. We run monthly networking events and regular virtual sessions, bringing together landlords, care operators, and property professionals. We’re building a community, and we need someone who can take ownership of making sure our social media content hits the mark, every time, on time.



About the Role

This is not a “just schedule some posts” role. You will be the person who makes sure our entire content operation runs smoothly. The founder writes the content and sets the direction; your job is to make sure it gets published correctly, on time, and to the standard our audience expects. You’ll coordinate between tea
mbers, chase deadlines, and be the quality gatekeeper for everything that goes out under the CPH brand.



You’ll also work with Opus Clip and recorded meeting footage to create short-form video clips, coordinating with our video producer (Soban) to turn raw recordings into polished social content. The person scheduling posts will report to you, you’re responsible for making sure everything is posted, not doing all the posting yourself.

LinkedIn is our primary channel, but you’ll also coordinate content across other platforms as we expand.



What You’ll Do

• Quality-control all content before it goes live — copy, images, links in comments, hashtags, tagging. If it’s not right, it doesn’t go out.

• Chase and manage the scheduler — the person posting content reports to you. You confirm everything is scheduled, published on time, and correct. “Has it been posted?” is your daily question.

• Work with Opus Clip to produce short-form video clips from recorded meetings and events. You’ll create initial cuts and pass them to Soban (our video producer) for final production, then ensure the finished videos are scheduled and posted.

• Coordinate the content pipeline — the founder writes the content and gives you direction. You make sure it moves through the chain (writing ? video production ? scheduling ? posting) without delays or errors.

• Report weekly on what’s been posted, what’s scheduled, what’s late, and what’s missing. No surprises.

• Propose creative ideas to grow our social media presence — especially video content. We have raw material and a growing community. We need someone who can see what’s working in the UK market and suggest what we should be doing next.



WHERE THIS ROLE CAN GO

This starts at 3 hours per week, but it won’t stay there if you’re the right person. We reward initiative with more responsibility, more hours, and more earning potential.

• Video strategy — we have meeting recordings, event footage, and founder content that could become a full video programme. If you can design and lead that, this role grows fast.

• Campaign strategy — help us sell more event tickets and attract more property listings to the platform. Prove you can drive results and the budget follows.

• Community growth — we’re not just posting content; we’re building a community in the UK care property sector. If you can grow that community, you become indispensable.

• Full Social Media Manager — for the right person, this grows into owning the entire social media and content function for CPH.



What We’re Looking For

• UK market knowledge — you know what’s working on social media in the UK right now, not just globally. You understand the UK audience, trends, and content formats that are actually getting results.

• Organised and relentless on deadlines — content schedules don’t manage themselves. You chase, you follow up, you don’t let things slip.

• Comfortable with video tools — experience with Opus Clip, CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar. You don’t need to be a professional editor, but you need to be able to produce clips from raw footage.

• Creative and proactive — you don’t wait to be told what to do. You research what’s working, propose ideas, and come to us with a plan. If you can pitch a new content project, we want to hear it.

• Comfortable with LinkedIn — you understand how professional B2B content works on LinkedIn, not just personal posting.

• Strong attention to detail — links in comments, correct hashtags, right images, no typos. Every post is checked before it goes out.

• Confident communicator — you’ll be coordinating between the founder, a video producer, and a scheduler. You need to be clear, direct, and not afraid to chase people.



Pay & Trial Period

Base salary + up to $15/hr commission based on results. The more value you bring, the more you earn. We measure results, engagement growth, content consistency, video output, community growth, and your commission reflects what you deliver.

4-week paid trial. The first four weeks are a paid trial period. If you deliver what’s expected and show you can add value, this becomes an ongoing role with room to grow. If it’s not working, we’ll part ways, no hard feelings.

Only apply if you genuinely know what you’re doing and can add value to the team. We’re a small, bootstrapped business, and every person matters. If you’re looking for a role where you can coast, this isn’t it.



What Success Looks Like in Your First 4 Weeks

• Week 1: Understand the full content pipeline — who writes, who produces video, who schedules. Meet the team. Review all current social channels and content.

• Week 2: Take over QA and scheduling coordination. Every post is checked before publishing. Opus Clip workflow started with Soban.

• Week 3: All content going out on time with zero errors. Weekly reporting in place. At least one Opus Clip video has been published.

• Week 4: Propose one creative content idea or campaign based on what you’ve seen working in the UK market. Prove you’re not just coordinating; you’re thinking.



The Practicalities

• Hours: 3 hours per week to start — flexible on when those hours fall. Scope to grow significantly.

• Location: Fully remote — UK-based or UK timezone required.

• Contract: Freelance/contract basis.

• Pay: Base salary + performance commission. Discussed during application.

• Tools: We’ll provide access to everything you need (Opus Clip, scheduling platform, content calendar, brand assets).

• Trial: 4-week paid trial period.



About Care Property Hub

CPH is a UK-based property matchmaking platform purpose-built for the care sector. We connect care providers who need properties with landlords and developers who have them. Our monthly networking events and regular virtual sessions have become a go-to meeting point for the sector, and our LinkedIn presence is growing fast.

We’re a small, bootstrapped team that moves quickly and values people who take ownership. If you want to be part of building something from the ground up and actually see the impact of your work, this is that kind of role.



How to Apply

We don’t want a CV. We want to see effort.

Fill out our short application questionnaire:
. 

It takes about 20 minutes and includes a 60-second video introduction. 



If you can’t be bothered to complete it properly, this role isn’t for you.

title: Executive Personal Assistant to CEO | Full-Time Remote
description:
We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, trustworthy Executive Personal Assistant to work directly with a busy entrepreneur/CEO.

RESPONSIBILITIES:



• Manage calendar, meetings, appointments, and reminders

• Follow up with tea
mbers and outside contacts

• Help organize content ideas, photos, videos, and social media responsibilities

• Keep confidential business and personal information private

• Identify problems early and help find solutions

• Learn my preferences so routine decisions require less of my time



IDEAL CANDIDATE:



• Excellent written and spoken English

• Extremely organized and detail-oriented

• Proactive and able to think ahead

• Strong online research skills

• Reliable and responsive

• Good judgment and problem-solving skills

• Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment

• Able to prioritize multiple requests

• Comfortable communicating with tea
mbers

• Experience with Google Calendar, Gmail, Google Drive, spreadsheets, ChatGPT, and similar tools

• Previous Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or high-level VA experience preferred



HOW I EXPECT YOU TO WORK:



Your job is to protect my time.



Don’t send me 15 options and make me research them myself. Research the situation, narrow it down, and bring me the best 2–3 options with your recommendation.



Don’t only tell me there’s a problem. Tell me the problem, what caused it, and what you recommend we do about it.



You will help maintain:



TODAY — Must be completed today

THIS WEEK — Upcoming priorities

WAITING ON — Things we’re waiting for someone else to complete

RECURRING — Tasks that happen regularly



You will also provide:



MORNING BRIEF — Today’s schedule, top priorities, important reminders, and decisions needed.



END-OF-DAY BRIEF — What was completed, what is still pending, what we’re waiting on, and priorities for tomorrow.







HOW TO APPLY:



Send:



A short introduction about yourself.

Your experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or Virtual Assistant.

The software/tools you know how to use.

Your expected monthly salary in USD.

Your availability and preferred working hours.

A link to a 60–90 second video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a good fit.



IMPORTANT: Put “CEO PA 100” at the beginning of your application.



SCENARIO TEST:



Imagine I message you:



“I’m flying to Miami Sunday. Find me a good nonstop flight, a nice hotel near Brickell, transportation from the airport, and a good steak restaurant for Sunday night.”



Show me EXACTLY how you would handle this request and what you would send back to me.



Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.



I’m looking for someone long-term who wants to grow into a trusted position with more responsibility and autonomy over time.

title: Maintenance Coordinator
description:
Job Summary 



We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and customer-focused Maintenance Coordinator to oversee and coordinate day-to-day maintenance operations across our managed residential properties. This role serves as the primary liaison between tenants, maintenance technicians, vendors, and property management, ensuring maintenance requests are handled efficiently from initial report through completion. 



The Maintenance Coordinator is responsible for scheduling repairs, monitoring work order progress, communicating with tenants, coordinating vendors, tracking maintenance performance, and ensuring excellent customer service throughout the repair process. 



In addition to coordinating repairs, the Maintenance Coordinator should possess a solid understanding of basic residential maintenance and troubleshooting. This individual will be expected to guide tenants through simple maintenance solutions when appropriate, helping resolve minor issues quickly and reducing unnecessary service calls. 



The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, and possesses excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Experience with property management software and maintenance operations is highly preferred. 



 



Key Responsibilities: 



Maintenance Coordination 

       Receive, review, prioritize, and assign maintenance work orders to maintenance technicians.  

       Coordinate technician schedules to ensure timely completion of repairs and service requests.  

       Monitor active work orders and proactively follow up on pending or overdue tasks.  

       Communicate with technicians regarding job progress, delays, required materials, and completion of updates.  

       Ensure completed work orders include accurate notes, photos (when applicable), and proper documentation before    closing.  

       Escalate emergency maintenance requests to the appropriate personnel for immediate action.  

       Coordinate preventative maintenance schedules to minimize future maintenance issues.  





 Tenant Communication 

        Serve as the primary point of contact for tenants regarding maintenance concerns and repair requests.  

        Respond promptly and professionally via phone,
, Microsoft Teams, and other communication platforms.  

        Schedule maintenance appointments and provide tenants with repair timelines and updates.  

        Keep tenants informed of any delays or scheduling changes.  

        Conduct follow-up communication after repairs to confirm work has been completed satisfactorily.  

        Maintain a high level of professionalism and customer service in all tenant interactions.  





Basic Maintenance Troubleshooting 

         Assist tenants in resolving simple maintenance issues remotely before dispatching a technician, when appropriate.  

         Provide clear, step-by-step guidance over the phone for basic troubleshooting tasks. 

         Help tenants with common maintenance issues such as:  

                   Resetting garbage disposals.  

                   Resetting tripped GFCI outlets.  

                   Identifying and flipping tripped circuit breakers.  

                   Replacing HVAC air filters.  

                   Check thermostat settings and batteries.  

                   Relighting pilot lights when appropriate and safe.  

                   Troubleshooting appliances using manufacturer-recommended reset procedures.  

                    Determine when an issue can be safely resolved remotely versus when an in-person technician is required.  

                    Educate tenants on basic maintenance practices that help prevent recurring issues.  



 

Pest Infestation Management 

       Receive, document, and assess tenant reports related to pest infestations, including rodents, insects, termites, bed bugs, and other pest concerns.  

       Determine the urgency of reported pest issues and prioritize cases based on severity.  

       Coordinate inspections and treatment appointments with licensed pest control vendors.  

       Schedule appointments with tenants and ensure access is available for inspections and treatments.

title: Afterhours Logistics Coordinator / Dispatcher
description:
Kwiksave Logistics Inc.

Afterhours Logistics Coordinator / Dispatcher



Remote – Philippines | North American Eastern Time



Position Overview



Kwiksave Logistics Inc. is a Canadian third-party logistics and transportation company providing time-sensitive transportation, warehousing and distribution services throughout Canada and the United States.



We are seeking a highly organized, technologically proficient and service-oriented Afterhours Logistics Coordinator / Dispatcher to join our growing Afterhours Operations Team.



This is not a passive call-answering position. The successful candidate will be responsible for proactively monitoring customer communications, active shipments, driver activity and outstanding operational requirements throughout the shift.



Our afterhours operations support several major North American customers with time-sensitive and on-demand transportation requirements. The position requires excellent English communication, strong attention to detail, comfort working independently and the ability to manage multiple live transactions simultaneously.



The successful candidate will work as part of a two-person afterhours team, providing simultaneous coverage and operational redundancy.



Key Skills



The successful candidate must demonstrate:



- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong computer and technological proficiency.

- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and spreadsheets.

- Ability to manage multiple
 inboxes and monitor incoming communications proactively.

- Excellent attention to detail and task follow-through.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills.

- Ability to prioritize competing tasks according to service urgency.

- Strong customer-service and professional communication skills.

- Ability to work calmly and accurately under time-sensitive conditions.

- Ability to learn transportation management, dispatch and customer portal systems.

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability.

- Ability to work collaboratively with another dispatcher while independently managing assigned responsibilities.



Previous transportation, logistics, freight, courier, dispatch, BPO or North American customer-service experience is considered a strong asset.



Responsibilities and Essential Job Tasks

1. Afterhours Transportation Dispatch



Coordinate and monitor time-sensitive transportation transactions throughout the assigned shift.



Responsibilities include:



- Receive and review new transportation requests.

- Dispatch qualified owner-operators according to shipment requirements.

- Communicate pickup and delivery instructions clearly to operators.

- Monitor active shipments from dispatch through completion.

- Track shipment status and anticipated pickup/delivery times.

- Identify shipments at risk of service failure.

- Take immediate corrective action or escalate when required.

- Coordinate dedicated and hot-shot transportation requirements.

- Support Canadian and United States transportation activity.

- Maintain accurate records of dispatch activity through customer portals and Kwiksave's transportation management software.



2. Proactive
 & Communication Monitoring



Continuous communication monitoring is an essential function of this position.



The Afterhours Logistics Coordinator is expected to:



- Continuously monitor designated customer and operational
 inboxes.

- Identify new transportation requests without waiting for a customer to call.

- Acknowledge time-sensitive customer communications promptly.

- Monitor outstanding requests requiring follow-up.

- Respond proactively when shipment status changes.

- Escalate unresolved or at-risk transactions.

- Ensure communications are not left unanswered between shift changes.

- Accurately and promptly update customer order portals with required shipment milestones, statuses, ETAs, and completion information.



The position requires proactive monitoring rather than reliance upon incoming telephone calls to identify outstanding work.



3. Customer Service & Communication



Provide professional afterhours support to Kwiksave customers, shipment recipients and operational partners.



Responsibilities include:



- Answer incoming customer telephone calls.

- Respond professionally to customer
s.

- Provide accurate shipment status updates.

- Communicate delays or service exceptions promptly.

- Follow customer-specific communication protocols.

- Coordinate with customers regarding pickup and delivery requirements.

- Support recipients of e-commerce and distribution shipments when required.

- Escalate significant customer-service concerns to Kwiksave management.

- Accurately and promptly update customer order portals with required shipment milestones, statuses, ETAs, and completion information.



The successful candidate must be comfortable communicating professionally with North American customers by both telephone and
.



4. Will-Call & Warehouse Coordination



Coordinate afterhours and early-morning will-call warehouse pickups from:



Kwiksave distribution centres; and

third-party/partner distribution centres.



Responsibilities include:



- Confirming pickup requirements.

- Coordinating operators.

- Communicating warehouse instructions.

- Monitoring operator arrival and pickup.

- Following up on exceptions.

- Ensuring the customer receives appropriate status updates.



5. Shipment Monitoring & Exception Management



The Afterhours Logistics Coordinator is responsible for actively monitoring open transactions rather than simply responding when a problem is reported.



The expected operating discipline is:



Monitor - Identify - Act - Communicate - Verify - Document



This includes:



- Regularly reviewing all open shipments.

- Identifying approaching service deadlines.

- Monitoring driver progress.

- Recognizing potential service failures before they occur.

- Requesting extensions or customer direction where appropriate.

- Escalating material operational issues immediately.

- Confirming successful completion.

- Ensuring transactions are properly closed and documented.



6. Reporting & Spreadsheet Management



Accurate customer reporting is an occasional component of the position.



Responsibilities include:



- Exporting  Microsoft Excel shipment trackers from Kwiksave's transportation management software

- Updating ongoing distribution load reports.

- Organizing shipment information by required fields.

- Maintaining accurate status, ETA and completion information.

- Preparing customer-required operational reports.

- Ensuring reports are distributed accurately and on time.



Candidates must be comfortable working independently in Excel. Spreadsheet competency will be evaluated during the recruitment process.



7. Team Coordination & Shift Handover



Afterhours operations are performed using a team-based model.



The successful candidate will:



- Work simultaneously with another Afterhours Logistics Coordinator.

- Communicate outstanding tasks between tea
mbers.

- Cross-check critical transactions where appropriate.

- Maintain clear ownership of assigned responsibilities.

- Provide complete shift handover information.

- Ensure no outstanding transaction,
 or customer requirement is lost between shifts.

- Support other Kwiksave operational departments when required.



Both afterhours tea
mbers will ultimately be cross-trained across all core responsibilities to provide operational redundancy.

Job Environment

Location



Remote – Philippines



Hours of Work



Kwiksave Logistics is a 24-hour operation.



Our core Transportation Operations Team operates from approximately 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. Eastern Time (Ontario, Canada).



The Afterhours Logistics Coordinator / Dispatcher will work:



7:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m. Eastern Time



The successful candidate must be able to work these hours consistently and reliably. Candidates should understand that the position is specifically intended to support Kwiksave's North American overnight operations and therefore requires working a schedule aligned with the Eastern Time Zone rather than standard Philippine business hours.

mbers

title: Product Setup Specialist
description:
At LaunchBrightly - 
 - we are on a mission to automate the process of capturing and keeping your product screenshots up-to-date across your help center. Our screenshot automation platform allows you to set up simple automation recipes to auto-generate screenshots of the latest version of your product and continuously update them in your help documentation as your product changes. 



Our work is remote, not distant. We're an async-first team that communicates in writing, moves fast, and trusts people to get things done without constant check-ins. No unnecessary meetings, no micromanagement — just clear ownership and focused work.



LaunchBrightly was founded in 2022, and is backed by prominent venture firms including IA Ventures, Tuesday Capital, and B Capital Group — as the Product Setup Specialist will become an integral member of an intimate 10-person team. If you like seeing your work directly impact customers — you’ll fit right in! 



Job Description



This is a high-volume, detail-oriented role focused on setting up and maintaining product screenshots at scale. You’ll spend most of your time working inside our tool, navigating web applications, and completing structured, repeatable tasks with a high level of consistency and accuracy.



Your primary responsibility is to create screenshot “recipes” using our internal Screenshot Recipe Builder - 
 - a point-and-click WYSIWYG tool that records the steps needed to capture specific screens within a customer’s product.



You'll be doing this at volume — often building many hundreds of recipes per month across multiple customer environments. The work is methodical and detail-oriented, and doing it well requires patience, focus, and a genuine interest in getting things right day after day. Much of the work is repetitive by nature — success in this role comes from being able to stay focused, consistent, and detail-oriented across a high volume of similar tasks.



This isn't a data entry job. You'll need to think carefully about each customer's product, make judgment calls about the best way to capture a given screen or feature, and stay sharp when something doesn't behave as expected. But you don't need an engineering background either — if you're comfortable navigating web applications, using browser dev tools occasionally, and can stay organized across a high volume of tasks — you'll be well-equipped for this role.



What you’ll be doing



You’ll be responsible for things such as:



- Creating large volumes of screenshot recipes across customer web applications and help center environments using our Recipe Builder



- Navigating customer web applications to understand their product UI and capturing the steps needed to automate each - screenshot using our Recipe Builder



- Identifying when something isn't working as expected and troubleshooting before escalating



- Spotting patterns across customer implementations — noticing what’s slow, what breaks often, and where things could be improved



- Documenting issues, bugs, and friction points clearly so the engineering team can act on them

Contributing feedback on the Recipe Builder itself — you'll use it every day, so your perspective on what could be improved is genuinely valuable



- Occasionally using tools like the Browser Console and dev tools to inspect or debug issues



What we are looking for



The most important things for this role aren't technical — they're about how you work:



- You're organized and consistent and can maintain quality across repetitive, high-volume tasks without losing focus or cutting corners



- You're detail-oriented and notice when something is off — and you care enough to investigate



- You communicate clearly in writing and can describe a problem or observation in a way that's easy for someone else to act on



- You take ownership and don't wait to be told what to do next — you figure it out and get it done



- You're comfortable working independently in an async environment



- You have a customer-first mentality, with an instinct to imagine how users will react and interact



- You're a team player who thrives in a collaborative environment but doesn't need hand-holding to make progress



Bonus point if you



These aren't required but will help you get up to speed faster:

- Some familiarity with browser dev tools or inspect element

- A basic understanding of HTML and CSS — enough to recognize selectors and read a DOM

- Any experience with QA, testing, or documenting product issues

- Experience using Postman or working with APIs in any capacity



What we offer

- Flexible working hours and locations. Your success is measured on outcomes

- A culture of no meetings that protects focus time and productivity

- Excellent start-up culture with openness and inclusiveness

- True ownership and autonomy over your role and the impact on the company

- Experienced founders with many years of successfully building product across multiple ventures

- Annual meetup as a team in New York City



What to expect in the interview process



Given the remote nature of our work setting, one of the core principles for how we operate as a remote team is written communication. And we therefore run a slightly unique interview process that begins with an
-based exchange to learn more about your background, communication style and overall fit for the role.



Stage 1 —
 exchange with our Co-founder Josh - 
 : We'll start with a written conversation to learn about your background, how you communicate, and why this role interests you.



Stage 2 — Short practical exercise: We'll ask you to complete a brief hands-on task that mirrors the kind of work you'd be doing in this role.



Final stage — A video call with one with our Senior Implementation Specialist, so we can connect more personally and make sure it's a good fit on both sides.

title: Client Onboarding Specialist - AI-Integrated Websites (GoHighLevel / Twilio experience preferred)
description:
We build AI-integrated websites for small businesses in the US. B2B. When a client

signs, you are the person who gets them live.



WHAT YOU'D ACTUALLY DO



A client signs. You take it from there:

- Run the intake call and get the full picture of their business

- Chase down assets: logo, photos, service list with pricing, hours, after-hours policy

- Get the domain pointed correctly, without ever asking for their password

- Get their phone sorted - usually forward now, port later, so nothing waits on a carrier

- QA the site before launch: mobile, click-to-call, booking, the AI answering correctly

- Record a 5-minute walkthrough for the client, then hand it over



You are managing 12-18 accounts at once, each 3-5 weeks long.



THE PART THAT IS ACTUALLY THE JOB



Chasing assets. Clients go quiet. They mean to send the photos and then they don't for

nine days. Your job is to break that stall - switch channel, set a real deadline, make

replying trivial. We launch on day 10 with stock imagery and swap later rather than

let a launch slip. That rule is written down so nobody has to argue about it at 9pm.



SECURITY - READ THIS PART TWICE



You will be inside live customer accounts. That means:

- We use delegated access, never shared passwords

- If a client texts you their password, you refuse it and set it up properly instead.

  Using a texted password is a fireable act.

- Your access is per-client, time-limited, and revoked the day the site goes live

- Every action is logged



Background check and ID verification required before you start. No exceptions.



WHAT IT PAYS



$1,400 - $1,600 per month, flat, by experience. Full-time contractor. No commission -

you are not selling, you are getting people live, and paying you on speed would be

the wrong incentive.



HOW What you'd be onboarding clients onto: scsai.app/studio



TO APPLY



Start your application with this exact phrase: ASSET CHASE



Include:

1. A 90-second Loom video answering one question -- "a client has gone quiet for

   5 days and go-live is in a week. What do you do?"

2. Your experience with GoHighLevel, Twilio, or DNS if you have it

3. Your monthly rate

4. Confirmation that you consent to a background check and ID verification



Applications without the phrase and the Loom won't be read. That's not a trick --

chasing your own application is the same skill as chasing a client's logo file.

You will take day-to-day ownership of Meta Ads and Google Ads across Sweden, Norway and the Netherlands. You will also connect advertising decisions with Shopify revenue, inventory, promotions and wider trading performance.



This is a hands-on performance role. Campaign creative will be supplied by our marketing team, so your focus will be campaign management, testing, optimisation, tracking and commercial results.

- Build, launch, monitor and optimise campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads.

title: Test a new Windows app, 10 minutes, $5 (plus ongoing work available)
description:
We are about to launch a Windows app and we need real people on real computers to install it, use it for a couple of minutes, and tell us what happened. That is the whole job, about 10 minutes.



What we need from you:



- A Windows 10 or 11 PC. Not a Mac, not a phone.

- Google Chrome.

- Willingness to install a desktop app and a Chrome extension, use them briefly, and report back.

- Willingness to follow a short script we will give you. It is a few simple steps, nothing technical.



To be straight about what this is, because we know how it can sound: we do not send files. You download it yourself from our website, which we will give you once we start, and you are welcome to scan it first. Nothing gets collected from your computer without you seeing it on your own screen first and d
 to send it.



What you get:



- $5.50 by PayPal, sent as soon as you report back, usually within a few hours. That is $5 for the work plus 50 cents on top, because PayPal takes a cut on international payments and again on the currency conversion. We would rather you actually end up with the $5.

- A free year of the app, starting right now. That is the $200 a year plan, free. It does voice dictation, screen recording with instant share links, and AI meeting notes. The three separate tools it replaces cost about $53 a month combined.



This is a small task, but it is also how we are finding people to work with regularly. We need virtual assistants, and we need technical people who can do customer support for this app, which means helping users install it, getting them set up, and answering their questions. If you do a good job here we would like to talk to you about ongoing work.



We are also putting together a referral program. If you know people or businesses who would get use out of this, there will be a monthly cut in it for you for as long as they stay. Tell us if that interests you.



When you apply, please tell us:



1. Are you willing to install a desktop app and a browser extension on your own Windows PC and tell us what happens?

2. Roughly how old is your PC, and does it have a graphics card, if you know?

3. What other work do you do? In particular, tell us if you have done virtual assistant work or customer support before, and whether ongoing work interests you.

title: united state based collectors
description:
# U.S. Consumer Debt Collector – Remote Philippines



### Payday Loans | Installment Loans | Auto Loans | Credit Cards



**Work From Home – Philippines**



We are a U.S.-based collection agency seeking experienced consumer debt collectors in the Philippines to work U.S. accounts.



This is **NOT a customer service or general virtual assistant position.** We are specifically looking for experienced collectors who know how to negotiate payments, overcome objections, establish urgency, secure payment arrangements, and consistently hit collection goals.



## EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Applicants should have at least **1–2 years of actual consumer collections experience**, preferably involving one or more of the following:



* Payday loans / short-term lending

* Installment loans / personal loans

* Auto loans / auto finance

* Credit cards

* Fintech / online lending

* Charged-off consumer accounts

* 30+, 60+, 90+ and severely delinquent accounts

* Third-party debt collection

* U.S. financial accounts



**U.S. collections experience is strongly preferred.**



## WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will manage assigned consumer accounts and communicate with customers primarily by telephone.



Responsibilities include:



* Make high-volume outbound collection calls

* Handle inbound consumer calls

* Negotiate settlements and payment arrangements

* Secure Promise-to-Pay commitments

* Identify ability and willingness to pay

* Handle consumer objections professionally

* Follow up on broken promises and missed payments

* Document every account accurately

* Maintain productivity and collection targets

* Follow company compliance procedures

* Work assigned accounts strategically rather than simply dialing accounts

* Meet individual monthly collection goals



## WHAT WE DO NOT WANT



This position is not intended for applicants whose experience is primarily:



* Customer service

* Appointment setting

* Sales

* Accounts payable

* General accounts receivable

* Virtual assistant work

* Non-voice support



We are looking for **actual debt collectors.**



## IDEAL CANDIDATE



You should be comfortable speaking with consumers who are seriously delinquent and be capable of controlling difficult conversations without becoming unprofessional.



Strong candidates will understand concepts such as:



**PTP • Broken PTP • Settlement • Payment Arrangement • Delinquency • Charge-Off • Skip/Locate • Right Party Contact • Account Documentation • Negotiation • Account Prioritization**



Knowledge of U.S. FDCPA/Regulation F collection requirements is highly preferred.



## WORK REQUIREMENTS



* Reliable high-speed internet

* Windows computer

* Quality USB headset

* Quiet and professional work environment

* Reliable backup internet preferred

* Ability to work U.S. business hours

* Strong spoken and written English



## COMPENSATION



**?30,000–?40,000 PHP monthly base salary depending on experience**



PLUS:



**Uncapped performance incentives/collection bonuses**



Top-performing collectors will have opportunities for advancement into:



* Senior Collector

* Team Lead

* Collection Supervisor

* Quality/Compliance

* Account Manager



## IMPORTANT – APPLICATION SCREENING



To apply, please provide:



1. Total years of debt collection experience

2. Companies/BPOs where you handled collections

3. Types of accounts collected

4. Whether you handled U.S. consumers

9. Your expected monthly base salary



**Applicants with payday loan, installment loan, auto finance, credit card, or charged-off U.S. consumer collection experience will receive priority consideration.**

title: Contractor Lead-Gen Sales Closer - 100% Commission, Uncapped (Remote)
description:
START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORD "UNCAPPED" OR IT WILL BE DELETED WITHOUT READING.



We run a lead generation company and we're building a commission-only sales team to sell lead-gen and appointment-setting packages directly to US contractors - roofing, HVAC, solar, plumbing, remodeling, landscaping, any home-services vertical. No restriction.



Here's the part most job posts hide: we don't have a fixed pricing model or commission structure yet, on purpose. We want people who've ALREADY done this exact job somewhere else, on commission, and know cold how the money actually works - what contractors pay, what a rep's cut looks like, how the process runs from first contact to signed client. You bring the playbook. We build the offer around what's proven to work.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



- Sell contractor clients on paid lead-gen / appointment-setting packages - your pipeline, our leads, or a mix

- Run the full sales process: prospect or work provided leads, qualify, handle objections, close, get paid

- Help us set real pricing - what a contractor pays per lead, per appointment, or per retainer, and what a profitable, fair commission structure looks like on top of that

- Report back on what's converting - vertical, deal size, objection patterns - so we sharpen the offer fast



WHO WE WANT



Someone who has personally closed contractor clients before - not generated leads for someone else to close, not dialed appointments and handed them off. Closed. Got paid. You know exactly how a sales rep makes real money when cost-per-lead is low, because you've lived it. You've survived on 100% commission before and you know how to manage the slow weeks.



YOU MUST HAVE



- Real closed contractor deals in the last 12 months you can name with numbers (vertical, deal size, what you personally earned)

- 100% commission-only (or clearly majority-commission) experience - not base-heavy sales

- A full sales process you can walk through end to end, with real follow-up cadence and real objection handling

- Fluent, persuasive English - you're selling directly to US business owners

- Self-sufficiency - you don't need a script or leads spoon-fed to start producing



BONUS POINTS



- Own contractor-industry relationships or a warm network already

- Depth in a high-ticket vertical (roofing, solar, HVAC) where deal sizes are biggest

- CRM/dialer experience (Close, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, PhoneBurner, Aircall, Mojo)

- You've trained or managed other closers or appointment setters



THE DEAL



100% commission, uncapped, no ceiling ever. We're building the exact structure WITH you based on what's actually worked in your past deals - this isn't a take-it-or-leave-it number pulled from nowhere. Fully remote, async-first, direct line to the owner, no middle management, full ownership of your book of contractor clients.



HOW TO APPLY



Start with "UNCAPPED", then answer ALL of these. Short, real, specific beats long and polished.



1. What are you doing right now (or most recently) in contractor lead-gen sales? Company/companies, vertical(s), your exact role.

2. Walk me through the exact PRICING model to the contractor - per lead, per appointment, % of job value, retainer, hybrid? Real numbers.

3. Your own commission structure on those deals - flat %, tiered, per-close bonus? One real example: deal closed, contract value, what you personally earned.

4. Walk me through your sales process end to end, first contact to signed/paid client. Follow-up cadence, top 2 objections and how you handle them.

5. How do YOU build your pipeline - cold calling, cold
, FB/LinkedIn outbound, referrals, inbound, warm network? Tools and volume.

6. Best closed deal in the last 12 months: vertical, deal structure, contract value, what you personally earned. We may verify.

7. Cost to generate each lead runs $15-30. How do you price it to the contractor so it's profitable for them AND leaves you real commission? Show your math.

8. Ever worked 100% commission-only with zero base? How did you manage pipeline risk / cash flow in slow stretches? Real story.

9. Average sales cycle for a contractor deal (first contact to signed/paid) and typical close rate out of qualified conversations?

10. When can you start? Availability (hours/week, timezone)?
