title: Build a Sales Team With Me - Contractor Lead-Gen Closer, Commission Only (Remote)
description:
START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORDS "LET'S CLOSE" OR IT WILL BE DELETED WITHOUT READING.



Let me tell you who I'm looking for, and be honest with yourself about whether this is you.



Somewhere out there is a closer who's already sold lead-gen or appointment-setting packages to contractors - roofers, HVAC guys, solar installers, plumbers - and made someone else rich doing it. They know the pricing, they know the objections, they know exactly how a cheap lead turns into a profitable deal for everyone. But they're capped. Same split every deal, no say in how the offer's built, no path past "closer #4 on the team."



If your heart rate just went up: hi. I built this for you.



WHAT THIS IS



I run a lead generation company and I'm building a commission-only sales team from scratch to sell directly to US contractors, any home-services vertical. There's no locked pricing model or commission structure yet - on purpose. I want the first person in to help build it, based on what's actually worked for them, not on a number I made up.



And here's the real offer - the part no ordinary closer job gives you:



If you're good, you're not staying a solo rep. You're the first hire in a sales org I'm building. That means real input into pricing, the sales script, which verticals we prioritize - and eventually, if you want it, training and running the next reps who join under you.



WHAT I EXPECT IN RETURN



Full honesty: I expect a lot.



- You've personally closed contractor clients on lead-gen or appointment-setting deals and can show me real numbers - vertical, deal size, what you earned. Not "helped close." Closed.

- You've worked 100% commission-only before and know how that changes how you operate day to day.

- You understand the actual economics - why a $15-30 lead cost doesn't mean a cheap sale, and how to price so the contractor, the deal, and your commission all make sense at once.

- You have a real sales process, not a vibe - prospecting, qualifying, objection handling, closing, follow-up.

- You figure things out. My favorite message from a rep is "already tried it, here's what converted" - not "what should I say?"

- You're hungry, genuinely. That part can't be taught.



WHAT YOU GET



- 100% commission, uncapped, forever - and a real say in building the structure, not a number handed down

- Every tool you need, on my card

- Direct access to someone building this for real, not theorizing about it

- A clear path: closer -> proven closer with input on the offer -> the person training and running the next reps



HOW TO APPLY



Start with "LET'S CLOSE", then answer these - short and real beats long and polished.



1. What are you doing right now (or most recently) in contractor lead-gen sales? Company, vertical(s), your exact role.

2. Walk me through the exact pricing model to the contractor you've worked under - per lead, per appointment, retainer, hybrid? Real numbers.

3. Your commission structure on real deals, with one real example: deal closed, contract value, what you personally earned.

4. Walk me through your sales process end to end, first contact to signed/paid client. Follow-up cadence, top 2 objections, how you handle them.

5. How do you build your own pipeline of contractor prospects? Tools and volume.

6. Tell me about a deal that FELL THROUGH - what happened, what did you learn, what would you do differently? (This one matters more than you think.)

7. Cost to generate a lead runs $15-30. How would you price it to the contractor so it's profitable for them AND leaves you real commission? Show your thinking.

8. Ever worked 100% commission-only with zero base? How did you manage the slow stretches? Real story.

9. Why you? Not your skills - I'll see those above. Why should I bet on YOU to be the first person in this sales org?

10. When can you start? Availability?



I read every application that follows the rules. The ones that don't answer question 9 for me.



If you've been closing deals that made someone else's company - and you're ready to help build one instead of just working in one - this is it. Let's close.

title: Senior Finance & Operations Manager (CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Position: Senior Finance & Operations Manager (CPA Preferred)



Location: Remote (Philippines)



Overview

We are a growing Canadian construction and service company looking for someone who wants more than a traditional accounting role.



We're looking for a reliable, proactive, and highly organized professional who can take ownership of our finance and administrative operations. This person will play a key role in helping leadership make informed decisions, maintain healthy cash flow, and ensure the business runs smoothly behind the scenes.



The ideal candidate is a self-motivated leader who anticipates business needs before they arise. We value a professional who communicates with clarity, maintains flawless organization, and demonstrates a relentless commitment to following through on every initiative.

- Weekly cash flow forecasting and reporting

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Strong understanding of cash flow management

- Superior proficiency in written and verbal English

- Highly organized with strong attention to detail

- Honest, dependable, and accountable

- Able to manage confidential financial information with integrity

- Positive attitude and willingness to continuously improve systems

We're looking for a highly organized, proactive, and dependable **Virtual Operations Manager** to become a key leader within our company. This is a long-term career opportunity for someone who wants to grow with a rapidly expanding business.

As our Virtual Operations Manager, you will oversee the daily operations of the company and ensure every department works together efficiently. You will help coordinate office staff, dispatch, customer service, scheduling, drivers, and customer communication while maintaining a high level of organization and professionalism.

* Oversee daily office operations and workflow

title: Amazon Wholesale VA - Brand Sourcing, Cold Calling & Ungating
description:
We are a US-registered wholesale distribution company sourcing branded products for Amazon FBA. We are looking for an experienced Virtual Assistant to own the front end of our wholesale funnel: finding the right brands, getting through to decision makers, and managing those brand relationships once they are live.

 

This is not an entry level role. We are only considering candidates who have already done this work for another Amazon wholesale seller.

 

THE TARGET

Deliver 2 to 3 qualified brands per month. A qualified brand means: the right decision maker reached, genuine interest confirmed, price list received, and products profitable at our ROI threshold.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 

1. Brand and product research

- Build the brand list yourself using SmartScout, Keepa and Seller Amp, based on agreed filter criteria (FBA seller count, dominant seller share, revenue range)

- Identify authorised US distributors using ImportYeti, USPTO and brand websites

- Analyse profitability: buy cost, Amazon fees, ROI and margin

- Screen out gated, IP-risk and Amazon-dominated brands before outreach

 

2. Contact sourcing and outreach

- Find direct decision maker contacts using tools such as Apollo, RocketReach, Hunter, Seamless, LinkedIn Sales Navigator or ZoomInfo

- Reach purchasing, national accounts or sales managers directly, not reception or a generic 

- Send wholesale enquiry
s and follow up on a set schedule

- Make outbound cold calls during US business hours using your own proven approach, and handle objections

- Request price lists, MOQ, payment terms and lead times, and pass everything to us with a clean summary

 

3. Account management

- Maintain ongoing relationships with our existing brands and distributors

- Monitor price list updates, promotions, MOQ changes and stock availability

- Chase quotes, order confirmations, shipping updates and missing paperwork

- Flag pricing changes that affect our margin

- Keep every brand record current: contact, terms, pricing, order process

 

4. Tracking and reporting

- Log every contact, call and follow-up in our tracking sheet

- Weekly report: brands contacted, connect rate, price lists received, qualified brands delivered, open items on existing accounts

 

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- Minimum 2 years hands-on experience with Amazon wholesale sourcing and brand outreach

- Confident spoken English, comfortable cold calling US brand owners and purchasing managers

- Skilled with SmartScout, Keepa and Seller Amp

- Skilled with contact sourcing tools (Apollo, RocketReach, Hunter, Seamless, Sales Navigator or similar)

- Strong Google Sheets or Excel: filtering, lookups, profitability formulas, clean tracking

- Organised follow-up habits, nothing falls through the cracks

- Reliable internet and a quiet space for calls

- Must overlap with US business hours (9am to 5pm EST)

- 20 hours per week, 80 hours per month, ongoing

 

WHAT WE PROVIDE

Phone number,
 templates and tool access. You will not be paying for anything out of pocket. If you need anything further during the role, such as AI tools, subscriptions or extra software, just let us know and we will look at it.

 

You are expected to bring your own calling approach, we do not hand out scripts. You will be the one calling and dealing with brands and distributors directly, so you need to be comfortable running those conversations on your own.

 

TRIAL AND GROWTH

Salary is USD 350 to 650 per month depending on your experience and track record. Tell us what you are looking for and back it up with results.



Paid 1 month trial, because a wholesale funnel takes weeks to produce a result, not days. We assess on the full pipeline, not just the final outcome. After the trial this becomes an ongoing role, with a performance bonus on top of your base rate for strong results.

 

We are early stage, so you get to build the full funnel with us rather than inherit someone else's system: your own research criteria, your own outreach approach, your own tracking and process. If you have wanted ownership over how a wholesale operation is actually run, this is that role. Real growth path: strong performers take on more of the Amazon account over time.

 

TO APPLY, PLEASE ANSWER

1. Which brands have you personally done wholesale outreach for?

2. Which categories have you worked in, and what results did you get?

3. Which research and contact sourcing tools do you use?

4. Fun one: if a brand owner picks up the phone and says "we don't sell on Amazon", what's your comeback? One line is fine.

 

Attach your CV or share your portfolio if you have one, optional.

 

Please start your message with the word MANGO so we know you read the full ad.

About Us



We run a fast-growing portfolio of direct-to-consumer health & wellness brands across international markets (UK, Ireland, Poland, Mexico, French Canada, Switzerland). The Role

What you'll do

- Build creative batches across the full funnel: TOF (attention & curiosity), MOF (trust & mechanism), BOF (offer & conversion)

- Match every ad to the right awareness stage (Unaware ? Problem Aware ? Solution Aware ? Product Aware ? Most Aware)

- Develop static/image ads as your core format, plus native-style ads (creator-style statics and long-form story ads)

- Research winning creatives via swipe files, spy tools, and competitor analysis — and translate them into fresh concepts, never copies

- Write clear, detailed briefs for editors: hook, copy, visual instructions, layout, references

- Analyze performance data (hook rate, CTR, ATC, ROAS, CPA) and iterate on winners systematically

- Work with proven direct-response frameworks: PAS, BAB, market sophistication levels, one ad = one concept



What we're looking for

- 2+ years of experience as a creative strategist or media buyer in DTC ecommerce or performance marketing

- Deep understanding of funnel stages (TOF/MOF/BOF) and Eugene Schwartz's awareness stages — you can classify any ad on sight

- Strong portfolio of static/image ads that actually performed (be ready to show numbers)

- Experience with native ad formats is a big plus

- You think in angles, mechanisms, and psychology — not just "nice visuals"

- Data-driven: you let performance d
, not opinions

- Fluent English; you can brief a team clearly and take feedback fast

- Self-managing and reliable — you own your batches end to end



What we offer

- $2,500/month retainer (5–6 days per week)

- Paid leave — real days off, fully paid

- Long-term culture — we invest in people who stay; this is not a 3-month gig

- Fully remote, work from anywhere

- A structured creative system with SOPs, swipe files, and frameworks — you won't start from zero

- Direct collaboration with the founder and a senior team of strategists and editors

- Real budgets and fast testing cycles — your ideas go live within days

title: TECHNICAL ONBOARDING MANAGER - $900 P/M + BONUSES (UP TO $1,400 P/M)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Social Media Manager & Short-Form Content Expert
description:
JOB TYPE: Full-Time Contractor

WORK SETUP: Remote / Work From Home

SCHEDULE: Flexible hours, with set weekly deadlines

SALARY:
USD (flexible based on experience)



ABOUT US

We help travel brands inspire unforgettable trips, support families relocating abroad, and empower female online coaches to build authority and scale their businesses. We're looking for a Social Media Manager to become the dedicated content creator behind these brands.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not looking for "just" a video editor. We're looking for someone who thrives in fast-paced creative environments, takes ownership, and loves transforming ideas into scroll-stopping Instagram content.



YOU MIGHT BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU ARE

 Passionate about storytelling. You understand how editing, music, pacing, design, and storytelling work together.

 Strong on editing instincts. Expert at photo dumps, reel text placement, and picking the best 3 seconds of any clip.

 Detail-oriented. You notice the small details that make content exceptional.

 Reliable. You keep promises, hit deadlines, and deliver consistently high-quality work.

 Growth-driven. Always learning, experimenting with new trends, AI tools, and techniques.

 High energy. Bringing positive energy and creativity to every project.



You'll work directly with the CEO/Strategist and execute the content strategy. No client-facing responsibilities required.



RESPONSIBILITIES

 Edit and assemble engaging Instagram Reels aligned with each client's creative direction.

 Design eye-catching Instagram Carousel posts that educate, entertain, and build authority.

 Edit Reels, talking-head videos, and storytelling content across multiple brands.

 Select trending audio/music and editing styles that maximize engagement and retention.

 Apply color grading, color correction, and audio balancing for polished output.

 Source natural-looking B-roll and supporting visuals.

 Create Instagram Stories using photos, videos, graphics, polls, countdowns, and interactive elements.

 Write engaging captions that match each brand's voice.

 Post approved content per the content calendar and maintain a cohesive feed.

 Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Kling AI, etc.) to improve workflows and efficiency.

 Review analytics and recommend content improvements.

 Revise content based on feedback while maintaining a high standard.

 Stay current on Instagram trends and formats.



REQUIREMENTS

 Proven experience creating engaging Instagram content, with a strong portfolio (Reels, Stories, Captions, Carousels).

 Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, and AI creative tools.

 Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, color grading, music selection, and visual detail.

 Ability to spot trends while maintaining brand consistency.

 Strong time management across multiple deadlines.

 High adaptability and openness to feedback.

 Clear, proactive communication and an ownership mindset.



WHAT YOU GET

Clear systems: SOPs, workflows, and project management tools already built for you.

Creative collaboration: Direct work with the CEO/Strategist, with real feedback and support.

Feedback that fuels growth: Regular, constructive feedback to sharpen your craft.

Flexibility with accountability: Manage your own schedule; we care about results, not micromanagement.

Growth opportunities: Perform well and take on additional client accounts as we grow.

This is a full-time contractor role. We are not looking for an agency.



HOW TO APPLY

 Please send a Loom introduction answering the below questions. Include the word "Pink" after your first and last name when you apply. Share your portfolio and tell us why you'd be excited to manage multiple Instagram accounts inside a fast-growing social media agency.



What do you find most rewarding about crafting captions?

 How do you keep branding consistent across graphics and thumbnails?

 Describe a strategy you've used to grow or engage an audience.

 How do you stay updated on trends?

 How do you balance content creation with admin tasks?

title: Go-To-Market Lead: Cold Email + LinkedIn Outreach (Smartlead + Aimfox) | Finance
description:
Go-To-Market Lead: Cold
 + LinkedIn Outreach (Smartlead + Aimfox) | Finance | $1,000/mo + 2.5% Commission, Uncapped



Full-time | Fully remote | Long-term role



We are a capital advisory firm (investment banking offer: we help companies raise equity and debt) with a 25+ person international team, growing aggressively. We are hiring one person to own our entire go-to-market engine.



The goal is simple and it is not a vanity number: 1,000,000 cold
s sent per month, ASAP, plus a serious LinkedIn outbound motion running alongside it. You build the machine, you run it, you scale it.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Cold
 on Smartlead: campaign setup, sequencing, copy testing, spintax, sending infrastructure, deliverability

- LinkedIn outreach on Aimfox (works like HeyReach): multi-step connection and message sequences, iteration, A/B testing

- Campaign management end to end: launch, monitor, iterate, kill what does not work, double down on what does

- Tracking and data: reply rates, positive reply rates, meetings booked, conversions. You report on what matters and nothing else

- The full GTM engine of the firm. This is not an assistant role. You are the operator



You are NOT the appointment setter. When positive replies come in, our setters and AI handle the booking. Your job is to keep the top of that funnel full of qualified positive replies. We already have a lead source at excellent prices, so lead cost is not your bottleneck. Execution is.



WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR

An indie-hacker-style cold
 operator. The kind of person who is genuinely obsessed with this game and follows the space closely (if you know the Nick Abraham school of cold
, you know exactly what we mean). Specifically, you:

- Know that open rates are a trap. You never track opens, you know why open tracking hurts deliverability, and the only metrics you care about are replies and positive replies

- Know where to buy inboxes and keep up with the new infrastructure providers. We use ScaledMail today, but if you can name three providers you would evaluate this month and why, that is the level we want

- Understand Clay and enrichment/waterfall workflows for building and cleaning lists

- Live and breathe spintax, copy rotation, domain and inbox ramp-up, warmup, and A/B testing at volume

- Have run LinkedIn sequences (Aimfox, HeyReach, Expandi or similar) and iterated them based on data

- Have a real interest in finance. You will be writing outreach for founders and CFOs raising capital. If markets, M&A and fundraising bore you, this will not work

- Take initiative. This is the single most important trait for us. Nobody will hand you a daily task list. You see a bottleneck, you fix it. You have an idea, you test it and show us the numbers



WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY

- You need instructions before you can act

- Your cold
 experience is a few hundred
s from one Gmail account

- You think warmup and deliverability are optional details

- You want to juggle this alongside five other clients. This is a full-time, dedicated seat



COMPENSATION

- $1,000 USD per month base

- PLUS 2.5% commission on every deal closed through the GTM engine you install. We are an investment banking advisory firm: closed deals mean five-figure fee events, so this is real money, and it is uncapped. If the engine performs, you should out-earn your base many times over



FIRST 30 DAYS

1. Audit our current Smartlead and Aimfox setup and infrastructure

2. Take over live campaigns and ship your first copy and sequence iterations in week one

3. Present your ramp plan to 1M
s/month: domains, inboxes, providers, warmup schedule, copy rotation

4. Own the weekly numbers: sends, replies, positive replies, meetings booked



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word DELIVERABILITY so we know you read this. Then answer these five questions (short and specific beats long and generic):

1. Open tracking: on or off? Why?

2. You need 500 new sending inboxes live this month. Which providers do you evaluate and why?

3. The best cold
 campaign you have personally run: list size, monthly volume, reply rate, positive reply rate, and one iteration that moved the numbers.

4. Rough plan: how do you scale from 100k to 1M
s/month without burning domains?

5. A LinkedIn outreach sequence you have run: tool, steps, and results.



A short Loom walking through a Smartlead campaign you built is a big plus. Applications that ignore the instructions above are deleted unread.

title: Creative Strategist — Join a Team That Actually Invests in You (Remote)
description:
Most creative strategist jobs look the same: churn out ads, hit numbers, burn out, move on. We built our company to be different.



The story



We own and operate a growing portfolio of health & wellness brands across the UK, Ireland, Poland, Mexico, French Canada, and Switzerland. Everything is in-house: strategy, creative, funnels, media buying. We've spent years building a real creative engine — documented SOPs, swipe files, testing frameworks, trained editors — and now we need one more strategist to help run it.



Because we work on our own brands with our own budgets, we think in years, not campaigns. That changes everything about how we treat the people on our team.



What the work actually is



You'll be the strategic brain behind our ad creatives:



- Planning batches across the full customer journey — from cold TOF ads that stop the scroll, to MOF ads that build trust through mechanism, to BOF ads that close the sale

- Applying awareness-stage thinking (Unaware through Most Aware) so every ad meets the customer exactly where they are

- Focusing on what we test most: static image ads, alongside native formats — story-driven, creator-style ads that blend into the feed

- Digging into research: customer reviews, competitor ads, market sophistication

- Briefing our editors with precision and reviewing what comes back

- Learning from data every week and getting sharper with every batch



You won't be figuring this out alone. You'll plug into an existing system, work alongside experienced strategists, and get direct feedback from leadership.



What you bring



- Proven experience as a creative strategist in DTC / performance marketing

- Fluency in funnel stages and awareness stages — this is our shared language, not a nice-to-have

- A portfolio of image ads with real results behind them

- Native ad experience (or genuine hunger to master the format)

- Curiosity about buyer psychology and the discipline to follow the data

- Strong written English and a team-first attitude



What you get



- $2,500/month retainer for 5–6 days per week

- Paid leave — proper, fully paid days off, because sustainable pace wins long-term

- A long-term home — we promote from within, we train our people, and we keep them

title: Creative Strategist for Fast-Growing E-Commerce Company
description:
# Creative Strategist for Fast-Growing E-Commerce Company (Meta Ads) 



## About Us



We run multiple fast-growing e-commerce brands selling across European markets. We move fast, spend serious budgets on Meta, and make decisions based on data — not opinions. We're looking for a Creative Strategist who can own the full creative strategy cycle: from research to brief to performance analysis.



## What You Will Do



**1. Ad Account Analysis**

- Dive deep into our Meta ad accounts every week

- Identify which ads are winning, which are dying, and WHY

- Break down performance by hook, angle, format, and audience — not just surface-level CTR/ROAS



**2. Customer Avatar Research**

- Go deep on our customer: pains, desires, objections, language, buying triggers

- Use reviews, comments, competitor communities, and surveys to build real avatar profiles — not generic templates



**3. Market & Competitor Research**

- Monitor the market and competitor ad libraries continuously

- Identify what angles, hooks, and formats are working for competitors right now

- Spot trends early and translate them into testable ideas for our brands



**4. Creative Strategy & Production**

- Turn research into clear, structured creative strategy briefs (hooks, angles, scripts, visual direction)

- Produce creatives yourself using your creative strategy methods

- Build a systematic testing pipeline: iterate on winners, kill losers fast



**5. Weekly Feedback Loop**

- Join a weekly call with our team to review creative performance

- Present what worked, what didn't, and your data-backed plan for the next iteration

- Continuously improve the creative system based on results



## Requirements (Non-Negotiable)



- **Minimum 3 years of experience as a Creative Strategist** for e-commerce / DTC brands running Meta ads

- **Proof of work is mandatory:** portfolio of creatives you strategized/produced, example creative briefs, and performance results (screenshots or case studies)

- Deep understanding of direct response marketing and Meta ads performance metrics

- Experience with competitor research tools (Meta Ad Library, spy tools, etc.)

- Able to write and structure creative briefs independently

- Strong English communication (written and spoken)

- Reliable internet and availability for a weekly performance call



## Nice to Have



- Experience with AI tools for creative production (image/video generation, AI copywriting)

- Experience with European markets

- Video editing or basic design skills (CapCut, Premiere, Canva, Figma)



## What We Offer



- Long-term, full-time position with a stable, growing company

- Real ownership: your strategy directly drives our ad spend decisions

- Direct access to decision-makers — no bureaucracy, fast feedback

- Room to grow as we scale



How to Apply



1. Start your application with the word **"Loud&Clear"** so we know you read the full post

2. Include your **portfolio / proof of work** (creatives, briefs, performance results)

3. Tell us in 3–5 sentences: describe one winning ad you strategized — the research behind it, the angle, and the result

title: Microsoft Visio 2D Designer – Bathrooms & Kitchens
description:
MICROSOFT VISIO 2D DESIGNER – BATHROOMS & KITCHENS



ABOUT OUR COMPANY



We are a growing online bathroom and kitchen company based in the Netherlands.



We help customers create practical and attractive bathrooms and kitchens while providing fair pricing, clear information and honest product advice.



To support our continued growth, we are looking for a careful and reliable 2D Designer who can create technically accurate bathroom and kitchen layouts in Microsoft Visio.



Both bathroom and kitchen layouts are created in Microsoft Visio.





ABOUT THE ROLE



You will translate customer measurements, sketches, photographs, product specifications and design requirements into clear, functional and technically accurate 2D layouts.



Technical accuracy is the most important requirement of this position.



A design should look clear and professional, but appearance must never come at the expense of correct measurements, proper product dimensions, practical usability or technical consistency.



You must be comfortable checking measurements, identifying missing information and reporting conflicts before finalising a design.



This is a remote, part-time position for approximately 14–16 hours per week. There is potential for the position to grow based on performance and business needs.





YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



- Create 2D bathroom layouts in Microsoft Visio.

- Create 2D kitchen layouts in Microsoft Visio.

- Reproduce rooms accurately using supplied measurements, sketches, photographs and existing floor plans.

- Position bathroom products, kitchen cabinets, appliances and other elements according to the customer brief.

- Add clear dimensions, labels and relevant technical notes.

- Check whether all products fit within the available room dimensions.

- Check doors, cabinets, drawers and appliances for opening conflicts.

- Identify missing, unclear or contradictory information.

- Ask questions before making assumptions that could affect the design.

- Revise layouts based on internal or customer feedback.

- Maintain clear file names, version numbers and revision notes.

- Export completed layouts in the required formats.

- Communicate regularly with the project manager and other tea
mbers.

- Follow our Microsoft Visio templates, drawing standards and quality-control checklist.





TECHNICAL ACCURACY – NON-NEGOTIABLE



Technical accuracy is a core responsibility of this position.



Every drawing must meet the following standards:





1. EXACT MEASUREMENTS



- Drawings must be created in millimetres.

- The correct drawing scale must be used.

- Room and product dimensions must be entered accurately.

- Products may not be resized or positioned based only on visual estimation.

- Supplied measurements may not be rounded, changed or corrected without approval.





2. ACCURATE ROOM STRUCTURE



The drawing must accurately include all supplied fixed room elements, such as:



- Internal wall dimensions.

- Corners and wall changes.

- Niches and boxed-in areas.

- Columns and structural obstacles.

- Doors and their opening directions.

- Windows and their positions.

- Radiators.

- Sloped ceilings or height restrictions.

- Plumbing, drainage, ventilation and electrical positions when supplied.





3. VERIFIED PRODUCT DIMENSIONS



- Products must be drawn using the approved product dimensions.

- Product dimensions must be checked against the supplied specifications.

- Width, depth and required installation space must be considered.

- Generic or estimated dimensions may only be used when clearly marked as provisional.

- You may not assume that a product fits without checking it.





4. COMPLETE AND CONSISTENT DIMENSIONING



The layout must contain enough information for another tea
mber to understand and verify it.



Depending on the project, this includes:



- Overall room dimensions.

- Wall lengths.

- Door and window positions.

- Product dimensions.

- Product positions measured from fixed reference points.

- Cabinet and appliance positions.

- Important gaps, fillers and clearances.

- Passage widths and opening spaces.



Dimension chains must be internally consistent.



The sum of individual measurements must correspond with the relevant overall measurement. Any difference must be reported before the layout is considered complete.





5. COLLISION AND USABILITY CHECKS



Before submitting a design, you must check that:



- Products do not overlap.

- Products do not extend through walls or fixed objects.

- Room doors can open correctly.

- Cabinet doors and drawers can open.

- Appliances can be opened and used.

- The proposed layout is practical.

- Relevant installation points remain accessible.

- The layout follows the customer’s stated requirements.





6. NO SILENT ASSUMPTIONS



You must never silently guess when information is missing or contradictory.



When you find a problem, you must:



- Identify the missing or conflicting information.

- Explain why clarification is necessary.

- Ask a clear and concise question.

- Record any approved assumption in the drawing or submission notes.



If supplied measurements do not add up, you must report the discrepancy rather than placing the missing measurement wherever it appears to fit.





7. MANDATORY QUALITY CONTROL



Every layout must be checked before submission.



You are responsible for checking:



- Roo
asurements.

- Product measurements.

- Product positions.

- Dimension chains.

- Doors and windows.

- Opening directions.

- Collisions and overlaps.

- Labels and technical notes.

- File names and version numbers.

- Required export files.

- Unresolved questions and assumptions.



Accuracy is more important than speed.



Repeated avoidable measurement errors, preventable collisions or unreported assumptions are not acceptable.





REQUIRED DELIVERABLES



Depending on the project, you will normally submit:



- The original Microsoft Visio file in VSDX format.

- A PDF export.

- A PNG or JPG preview when requested.

- A clearly named project file.

- The correct version number.

- A short submission or revision note.

- A list of any open questions or approved assumptions.





REQUIRED SKILLS



- Practical experience using Microsoft Visio.

- Experience creating accurate 2D floor plans or room layouts.

- Ability to work with scaled drawings and millimetres.

- Ability to enter exact dimensions and positions.

- Ability to read floor plans, sketches and product specifications.

- Strong understanding of measurements and dimensioning.

- Exceptional attention to technical detail.

- Ability to identify conflicting or missing information.

- Ability to translate a customer brief into a functional layout.

- Clear written communication in English.

- Ability to receive feedback and accurately process revisions.

- Structured file-management habits.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

- Reliable internet connection.





PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:



- Bathroom design.

- Kitchen design.

- Interior layouts.

- Architectural drafting.

- Technical drawing.

- Space planning.

- Cabinet or furniture layouts.



Bathroom and kitchen product knowledge is helpful but not mandatory.



We will provide training in:



- Our bathroom and kitchen products.

- Our internal design standards.

- Our Microsoft Visio templates and shapes.

- Our file structure and naming conventions.

- Our quality-control process.

- Our internal workflow.



We can train you in our products and processes, but you must already possess basic Microsoft Visio skills and the ability to work carefully with measurements.





COMPUTER AND EQUIPMENT REQUIREMENTS



You must have:



- A reliable Windows computer capable of running the Microsoft Visio desktop application.

- A stable internet connection.

- A suitable remote working environment.

- The ability to attend agreed online review meetings.



We will provide the required Microsoft Visio licence.





WORKING HOURS AND AVAILABILITY



This position requires approximately 14–16 hours per week.



Working hours are flexible, provided that you:



- Meet agreed deadlines.

- Provide regular progress updates.

- Respond to feedback within the agreed time.

- Attend scheduled online review meetings.

- Communicate delays or problems in advance.

- Do not disappear without communication.





SALARY



The starting salary is €125 per month for approximately 14–16 hours per week.



Performance bonuses may be available.



Salary and responsibilities will be reviewed regularly. Increased compensation and growth into a larger or full-time position may be possible based on:



- Technical accuracy.

- Reliability.

- Communication.

- Productivity.

- Ability to work independently.

- Business requirements.





BENEFITS



- Paid Time Off eligibility after 1.5 months.

- Salary reviews every 2–3 months.

- Performance-based salary increases.

- Performance bonuses.

- Menstrual leave in accordance with company policy.

- Access to professional-development courses.

- A second monitor after six months.

- A company-provided laptop after two years.

- Training in our products, processes and drawing standards.

- Opportunities to take on additional responsibilities.





HOW TO APPLY – READ CAREFULLY



We personally review applications.



Generic applications that do not answer the questions below will not be considered.



Use this exact subject line:



MILLIMETER | Visio Designer | Your Full Name



The first word of your application must be:



MILLIMETER



Answer all questions below in the same numbered order. Keep your answers concise and specific.





1. MICROSOFT VISIO EXPERIENCE



How long have you worked with Microsoft Visio?



Briefly explain:



- What types of drawings you have created.

- Whether you have created scaled floor plans.

- Whether you have worked with exact dimensions and positions.

- Which version of Microsoft Visio you normally use.





2. RELEVANT WORK EXAMPLE



Provide a link or attachment containing one or two examples of a technically dimensioned 2D layout that you personally created.



For each example, state:



- Which software you used.

- Which parts you created yourself.

- Whether the measurements came from a room survey, sketch, floor plan or customer brief.

- What you checked before submitting the drawing.



Please remove confidential customer information.





3. TECHNICAL ACCURACY QUESTION



A customer sketch states that a wall is 3,000 mm long.



The measurements shown along this wall are:



- 850 mm

- 900 mm

- 700 mm

- 450 mm



What do you notice, and what would you do before continuing with the design?





4. MICROSOFT VISIO QUESTION



You need to place a cabinet measuring exactly 600 × 580 mm in a drawing.



Explain how you would ensure that the cabinet is entered at exactly this size in Microsoft Visio rather than resizing it visually.





5. QUALITY-CONTROL QUESTION



List the five most important technical checks you would perform before submitting a bathroom or kitchen layout.





6. MISSING-INFORMATION QUESTION



You receive a customer sketch containing the overall roo
asurements, but the exact position of the door is missing.



The design is requested urgently.



What would you do?





7. AVAILABILITY AND EQUIPMENT



Please confirm:



- Your time zone.

- Your normal available working hours.

- Whether you can work approximately 14–16 hours per week.

- Whether you have a reliable Windows computer.

- Whether you have a stable internet connection.

- Whether you can attend agreed online review meetings.

- Whether you understand and accept the stated starting salary.





SELECTION PROCESS



Our selection process consists of:



1. Review of your application answers and portfolio.

2. A short technical-accuracy assessment.

3. An online interview.

4. A paid practical Microsoft Visio assignment.

5. A final discussion and job offer.



The practical assignment will use fictional project information and will not be used as customer work.



Only applicants who follow the application instructions and demonstrate sufficient technical understanding will proceed to the next stage.



We look forward to reviewing your application.

description:
Please follow the application instructions below



PropFix.ie is Ireland's trusted property maintenance specialist, offering comprehensive solutions with years of expertise across the construction and renovation sectors. We transform spaces through our diverse range of services, from handyman solutions and office fit-outs to complete renovations, house extensions, and specialized installations including doors, floors, and partitions.



Our commitment to delivering high-quality property maintenance and electrical solutions has made us a trusted partner for residential, commercial, and industrial clients nationwide. With decades of experience in electrical systems, installations, and maintenance, we take pride in our technical expertise and craftsmanship—ensuring our clients’ properties remain safe, efficient, and fully compliant with modern standards.



Role Overview



We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Electrical Engineer to join our team. This role involves electrical design, project coordination, system analysis, and technical documentation. The successful candidate will work closely with project managers, site teams, and clients to ensure accurate planning, safe installations, and seamless execution of all electrical works—from concept design to project completion.



Key Responsibilities

Electrical Engineering & Design



Electrical System Design: Develop, review, and interpret electrical plans, schematics, and load calculations.

Technical Specifications: Prepare detailed specifications, diagrams, SLDs (single-line diagrams), and layout drawings.

Material & Equipment Selection: Determine appropriate electrical components, materials, and equipment required for projects.

Compliance & Standards: Ensure designs meet electrical codes, safety standards, and regulatory requirements.



Project Coordination & Client Management



Site Coordination: Work with contractors, site engineers, and electricians to ensure proper installation and site execution.

Client Communication: Liaise with clients to clarify requirements, provide technical updates, and explain engineering decisions.

Documentation: Prepare project reports, progress updates, testing results, QA/QC records, and risk assessments.

Change Management: Document revisions to electrical plans and update load calculations, cost impacts, and schedules accordingly.



Testing, Maintenance & Quality Control



System Testing: Perform testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of electrical systems and equipment.

Preventive Maintenance: Evaluate system performance and recommend maintenance schedules or upgrades.
